messages:
sam: Heads-up team: small coordinated release tonight during quiet window 22:00-02:00 UTC. Changes touch api, runtime, console, and router. Need explicit handback owners and rollback playbooks in this thread.

deploy-bot: Scheduled: 22:00-02:00 UTC. Runbooks RB-421 & RB-422 attached. Please ack and paste rollback snippets.

chen: Runtime owning. I'll pin model-serving to rwinference:2.4.0-canary and start with 3% traffic. Disabling auto-quant for canary. I'll also enable verbose KV eviction metrics.

julie: Taking API. There's a minor schema adjustment to /v1/generate. Plan: gate it behind a flag targeting canary only. Console team will run with backcompat gate on.

maria: Router owner. I'll prepare a header-based split at the edge. Plan: shadow traffic then 1% -> 5% -> 20%. Won't touch config until runtime canary OK.

sam: Proposed rollout sequence: runtime canary (3% -> 10% -> 50% -> full), router header-swap shadow -> gradual, API flag to canary, console flip last. Rollback/trip criteria: sustained p95 > 2000ms for 5m, 5xx rate increase >5ppt, or KV miss spike >20%.

chen: For runtime: if KV miss rate jumps >20% for 3 consecutive 1m windows I stop the canary and roll back the runtime image. Also watch GPU OOMs — page if >2 OOMs in canary.

julie: API: If any Console-originated errors (client id prefix C-) appear in first 15m, revert schema flag immediately and unpin canary route. Also watch api-request-latency p95 by client.

maria: Router: I'll run a 60s shadow and then a 30s ramp. If header routing mismatch >=0.5% or routing 5xx spikes we revert header-swap. I'll tag the change with owner=maria and runbook=RB-422.

sam: ops-oncall, can you prepare a short-lived alert channel and enable synthetic checks for the canary routes and console flows? We'll need paging thresholds set to the rollback criteria.

ops-oncall: Yep. I'll stand up #ephemeral/deploy-1762469999 and hook the p95/5xx/KV-miss alerts. Paging enabled for Sev2 (page) on thresholds. Will watch 30m post-100% too.

deploy-bot: Preflight: infra green, images present (rwinference:2.4.0-canary), console build v8.1-backcompat uploads OK. No blocking issues.

chen: Pin & canary commands I'm planning:```bash
infractl pin --pool runtime-prod --image rwinference:2.4.0-canary --note "nightly cross-svc canary"
deploybot canary --service runtime --percent 3 --duration 15m
```

julie: API gate call:```http
POST /admin/feature-flags
{ "flag":"schema_v2", "state":"canary", "scope":"api-canary" }
```

maria: Router rollback snippet:```bash
rtrctl set --route header-split --version v0.9.2 --meta "rollback by maria"
```

chen: Runtime rollback:```bash
deploybot rollback --service runtime --to-image rwinference:2.3.8 --reason "KV-miss/latency regression" --immediate
```

julie: API rollback is flip flag -> previous and remove canary target. I'll paste exact curl in the channel at T-minus 5.

sam: Final: owners ack (✅), runbooks linked (RB-421, RB-422), preflight green (✅), rollback cmds in thread (✅), ops monitoring on (✅). We'll start at 22:05 UTC to allow staging. If anyone hits thresholds call rollback, ping @ops-oncall + @deploy-bot and mark incident. Thanks :thumbsup:
